t=; if [ -n "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then set -- "$TOOLU_BIN"; else set -- /opt/homebrew/bin/toolu /usr/local/bin/toolu /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/toolu "$HOME/.local/bin/toolu" "$(command -v toolu 2>/dev/null)"; fi; for c in "$@"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then case $("$c" --hook-protocol 2>/dev/null </dev/null) in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) t=$c; break;; esac; fi; done; if [ -n "$t" ]; then exec "$t" hook session-start --event SessionStart --plugin-root "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; fi; if [ -z "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then b=; for c in "$TOOLU_BUN" "$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then b=$c; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$b" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/session-start.js" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'toolu plugin: native toolu not found, running the Bun bundle for this transition release - see #425. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu.' >&2; exec "$b" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/session-start.js"; fi; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"toolu plugin: toolu is not installed - checked TOOLU_BIN, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and PATH, and a TOOLU_BIN that is not a native toolu is never replaced. Install it with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash, or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu. Then restart the session. See docs/install.md."}'; exit 0
